items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I had my eye on him [Jeff]

ctx.x: What else do you remember about that particular show?

Well, I know Cab was out in front; he was singin' and doin' his thing, but I listened for the precision and the rhythm was beautiful, but I had my eye on Chu and then, after I heard Jeff, then I had my eye on him. But that was the highlight of that evening for me, 'cause my father knew I loved Chu Berry, see?
So just you and your father went?
